name: Mackinac Island (United States)
description: Purple upper part and light blue lower part divided by a white wave, charged with a green disc in a white horseshoe under three white stars and the arched words MACKINAC ISLAND.
history: Mackinac Island is a city in Mackinac County in Michigan. The flag was adopted in 2009 (the original design won a contest in 2008 and was modified in 2009, the horseshoe shape and the arched name being added after feedback from the city council and community, according to Flags of the World citing the Mackinac Island Town Crier).

features.role: green disc in a white horseshoe
